courseOutcomes.description: Understand the basic components, layout configurations, and functions of Flexible Manufacturing Systems (FMS).
Remember the classification of manufacturing cells, features and requirements of unattended machining, and principles of the Toyota Production System (TPS).
Apply the knowledge of CAD and CAM considerations in planning and implementing FMS.
Understand the automated material movement, storage systems, and tool management in FMS operations.
